Name: Wayland linux-drm-syncobj Protocol
QtUsage: Used in the Qt Wayland client (QPA) API
Description: The Wayland linux-drm-syncobj protocol allows a client to synchronize buffer access with the compositor using DRM synchronization object timeline points (explicit sync)
